title: The man who sold the Eiffel Tower

scenes.narration: In 1925, a man sold the Eiffel Tower. He didn't own it.
Paris, 1925. The tower is rusting, and expensive to keep standing. Victor Lustig reads that in a newspaper, and sees an opportunity.
He forges government letterhead, and invites six scrap dealers to a secret meeting at a luxury hotel.
The city, he says, is quietly selling the tower for scrap. Seven thousand tons of iron. And nobody can know.
One dealer, Andre Poisson, pays. Lustig takes the money, and catches the next train to Vienna.
And Poisson never calls the police. He's too embarrassed.
So a month later, Lustig comes back. And tries to sell the tower again.
